versions.changelog:
Initial release: Douyin search and analysis skill for public data research.

- Enables searching Douyin videos/posts/users, fetching creator content, reading comments, and viewing real-time trending topics.
- Supports keyword mapping and scenario-based intent recognition—even if users don't mention "Douyin."
- Pure CLI tool; works with Node.js (no extra dependencies), using only public data—no login, publishing, editing, or downloading.
- Strict token handling: environment variable only, never prints or stores tokens; outputs only neutral error messages if token is invalid.
- Results in JSON, detailed parameter mapping, clear error handling, and usage examples included.
- For internal research and analysis only; respects Douyin terms and privacy.
